test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 35

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 480, then the result is the same number. 20% of the same number is:
₹7,426 is divided among A, B, C and D in such a way that the shares of A and B, B and C, and C and D are in the ratios of 2 : 3, 4 : 5, and 10 : 3, respectively. The share of A (in ₹) is:

If 25 people, working for 10 hours a day, can complete 2 units of work in 5 days, then how many days will be required for 10 people to complete 18 units of work, if each person works for 9 hours a day?
Sachin deposited a sum of ₹68,750 at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The total amount (in ₹) received by Sachin after 4 years is:
A truck is moving at a speed of 90 km/h. If its speed is reduced by 67%, the new speed of the truck (in km/h) will be:
The volume (in m3) of a cuboidal tank, whose dimensions are given as 8 m × 25 m × 5 m, is:
The average of the first 13 multiples of 4 is:
The areas of three adjacent faces of a solid cuboid are 75 cm2, 125 cm2 and 240 cm2. What is the volume (in cm3) of the cuboid?

A goods train and a superfast train started running from station A and station B, respectively, at the same time towards each other on parallel tracks. If distance between station A and station B is 231 km, and the trains are running with speeds of 31 km/hr and 46 km/hr, respectively, then at what distance (in km) from station B will the trains meet?
A notebook is listed at ₹200 with a discount of 25%. What additional percentage discount must be offered to the customer to bring the net price to ₹117?

The list price of an article is ₹2,300 and a discount of 72% is offered on the list price. What additional discount percent on the already discounted price must be offered to a customer to bring the net selling price to ₹515.20?
Evaluate the following.38 − 9 ÷ 3 × 4
In what ratio should sugar costing ₹33 per kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹87 per kg so that by selling the mixture at ₹90.2 per kg, there is a profit of 10%?
If 30, 85, 66, and y are in proportion, then the value of y is:
The population of a village was 1,10,000. It increased by 15% in the first year and increased by 25% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
A shop that sells towels has offers going on, wherein customers can buy 3 towels and get 2 free. What is the percentage discount that the customer gets?
The average of 13 numbers is 14. If each number is multiplied by 3, then what will the new average be?

A, B and C, when each is working alone, can do a piece of work in, respectively, 11, 88 and 11 days. They all started the work together, but A left after 2 days. In how many days, was the remaining work completed?
Naresh deposited a sum of ₹31,250 at 4% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The total amount (in ₹) received by Naresh after 3 years is:\
By how much is 30% of 75 greater than 30% of 35?
